column1: # Two-choice letter judgements from group images (see docs/METHOD). "first" = letter of the first transcription; "other" = the alternative offered
# (disputed: the second reader's letter; sample/planted: a similar-looking letter). message: t = frame 0993 (typed), h = frames 1025-1027 (hand-written).
# group = part_number-of-group-in-part. redone = yes: the group image of the first round was cut wrongly; the answers are from the second round with corrected images.
